leadText: Ayane Sakura (Japanese: 佐倉 綾音 Sakura Ayane) is a Japanese voice actress for and .
plainText:
Ayane Sakura (Japanese: 佐倉 綾音 Sakura Ayane) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Sakura was born on January 29, 1994, in , , , , and became an actress as an adult. She gained several small roles in before gaining her most notable role during voicing Orla of the Rising Volt Tacklers.
